meaning: Failed elimination (#497), from no premises. The Meinongian rival STMT-ACTUALITY-WITHOUT-BEING is the contradictory of STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING in the shared vocabulary: the two are jointly inconsistent, and any refutation of the rival is the double-negated premise. Among subsets of the tested premise set (the target, the other seven act/potency premises, sensible motion and the regress premise), the only inclusion-minimal refuting core is the premise itself (open): model M2 satisfies the rival with the other nine. Other assumptions over the same predicates, such as 'everything is in act in esse', also refute the rival, but each entails the double-negated premise and would be a new open premise. No refutes relation is recorded: it would rest on the open target it defends (#391). This proves nothing about the rival's philosophical truth or about premise sets outside those tested.
